Senses.Explanation: Guest and host interpenetrating names a relation in which each position includes and exchanges with the other. It is classified as a turning phrase and is also requested directly in public questioning. one guest-host relation: classification, explanation, and direct question all concern interpenetration interpenetrating makes the two roles interpenetrate; bare guest and host can merely list the pair and is not enough for this entry. Guest-and-host interchange is a close formula, while the question explicitly sets aside the neighboring relation of relative and absolute.
